claimed: live mode as a general networked component: PASS.md B3 (F-b3-09) records this capability's tool today only as 'in place' -- there is no separate document-validation service with an endpoint or key on this host, so adapters/live.py's 'live' component is a real, operator-named schema store directory rather than a network call. That directory reachability has been measured here (see measured.live); a genuinely remote/networked schema store has not

adapters/second.py's out-of-process path (DOCVALID_SECOND_SUBPROCESS=1) is a faithful stub of a compiled validator reached out of process, per the author brief: measured to produce the same outcomes as the in-process compiled path on this harness's fixtures, but it recompiles the schema in the child on every call rather than keeping a resident compiled process, so its start-and-teardown cost is not what a production out-of-process validator would report

the standard's version is unverified: every record on file for it (X-cap-document-validation-001..006) is a search result, not a fetched page; docs/acceptance/matrix.json records this absence by owner on 2026-09-03 (STATUS row 45: page fetch is blocked in this environment)

the JSON Schema 2020-12 keyword subset both adapters support is exactly what examples/end-to-end/run.py's in-place checker already supports ($ref, anyOf, if/then/else, type, const, enum, pattern, min/maxLength, minimum, maximum, minItems, contains, items, required, properties, additionalProperties); no conformance case exercises a keyword outside that subset, and the official JSON Schema Test Suite (X-cap-document-validation-004) has not been run against either adapter here
